complicacoes.texto: The Blue Lantern rings are fueled by hope. If the wearer of the ring and others near the wearer of a Blue Lantern power ring lose hope, the ring ceases to function.

The Force Manipulation Arranjo of the Blue Lantern Power Ring only functions while within Alcance de Percepção of a Green Lantern, also Voo and Campo de Força graduações are halved when out of this range.
